cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Morton R. Goldsmith, Scarsdale, New York, 1920s; William Weiss, New York, NY, by exchange, 1930s; Private collection, New York, NY, gift, by 1950 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, 14 April, 1946. . . . Purple eggplant on white plate. Early. Owned Morton R. Goldsmith. . . ." Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: O'Keeffe dates this 1924." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks dated 1924. Dated 1923 on basis of verso inscription 1. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription.
titles.title: Eggplant

description: A dark purple eggplant with a bright green stem sits at the center of the composition on a white plate. Underneath the plate is a rippling white cloth.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
